# Andy

> A personal design system. Headless React, Geist type, Linear craft.

## Install in other projects

```bash
npx shadcn@latest registry add @andy=https://andy.vercel.app/r/{name}.json
npx shadcn@latest add @andy/theme @andy/button
```

## Principles

- Craft is the product. Spacing, type, and states are the work.
- Decide before decorating.
- Neutral does the work. Color is punctuation. Primary is blue 700 (`#3B66E0`).
- Dual chrome: floating tools are dense and elevated; content surfaces are quiet.
- Suggest, never assume.
- Three radii: 4 / 8 / 12. Spacing on a 4pt grid.
- Motion is short: 100–120ms ease-out hovers.
- Keyboard is first-class.
- Use semantic tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`). Never raw `bg-blue-500`.
- Forms use FieldGroup + Field. Items live in their Group.
- Base UI uses `render={}` not `asChild`.

## Foundations

- Colors: `/colors`
- Typography: Geist Sans + Geist Mono, `/typography`
- Materials: `/materials`
- Components: `/components`

Every docs page is the source of truth. Prefer installing primitives over rewriting them.
